_comment: Studio import: Fetch → MAF. Runner needs network + WFENGINE_OPENAI_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY). httpbin JSON becomes upstream context for researcher/reviewer.

config.taskInstructions: Base your analysis only on the merged workflow JSON (includes HTTP response under upstream keys). Be concise.

agents.name: researcher
agents.systemPrompt: Read the upstream workflow JSON and summarize the most important facts in 3 short bullet points.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.systemPrompt: Critique the researcher's bullets: note one risk and one thing to double-check.
